## Priority pages

- / : Home. Licensed electrician for panel work, troubleshooting, EV chargers, and emergency calls across Olathe and KC metro.
- /areas/olathe-ks.html : Olathe hub. Local service coverage, permits, and common residential electrical work in Olathe.
- /services/panel-upgrade.html : Panel upgrade (often 100A to 200A) with permits and inspection.
- /services/panel-replacement.html : Replace failed, burned, rusted, or obsolete panels (including Federal Pacific and Zinsco).
- /services/electrical-troubleshooting.html : Diagnose and repair flickering lights, dead circuits, and breaker problems.
- /services/ev-charger-installation.html : Level 2 home EV charger installation with dedicated circuit and permits when required.
- /services/emergency-electrician.html : After-hours response for sparking panels, burning smells, and total power loss.
- /services/surge-protection.html : Whole-home surge protection installed at the panel.
- /services/gfci-outlet-repair.html : GFCI diagnosis, repair, and code-required installs in wet areas.
- /services/dedicated-circuits.html : Dedicated circuits for high-demand appliances, shops, and EV loads.
